rationale: Price is trading below both the session VWAP ($36.60) and the 9-EMA ($35.88), sitting at only 33% of today's range after pulling back significantly from the $38.28 high, indicating the intraday momentum has faded. The last five 1-minute candles show a consistent drift lower with no clear reversal signal, and with 56 minutes to close and a forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable given the compressed ATR ($0.19) relative to the wide spread and the stock's already-extended gap of 13.28%. The existing working NVDA long already consumes 3% of buying power, and adding a correlated industrial name in a deteriorating intraday structure does not offer a compelling edge.
